title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Maintenance Fee and Waiver Levels
content:
The monthly maintenance fee of a Savings & Money Market Accounts product, and the levels at which each tier lets the owner avoid it, are listed below for all six tiers. Where a cell reads "not offered", that tier has no such waiver route at all.

## Fee and waiver levels

| Tier | Monthly maintenance fee (USD) | Lowest daily balance that waives it (USD) | Automatic transfer from checking that waives it (USD, at least) | Owner younger than (years) | Personal Checking tiers whose active account waives it | Relationship balance that waives it (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | 5.00 | 300.00 | 25.00 | 25 | not offered | not offered |
| Statement Savings | 5.00 | 300.00 | 25.00 | not offered | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | not offered |
| Goal Builder Savings | 0.00 | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered |
| Money Market Account | 12.00 | 2500.00 | not offered | not offered | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 15000.00 |
| Premier Money Market | 20.00 | 10000.00 | not offered | not offered | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 25000.00 |
| Private Client Money Market | 25.00 | 100000.00 | not offered | not offered | Private Client Checking | 250000.00 |

## Meaning of each level

- **Maintenance fee** is the dollar charge that falls due when a statement cycle closes, unless some waiver is satisfied.
- **Lowest daily balance**: when the account's end-of-day balance never drops beneath this figure on any day of the cycle, the fee is waived.
- **Automatic transfer**: automatic transfers from a checking account that post during the cycle and together reach at least this many dollars waive the fee.
- **Age**: an owner who has not reached this age by the close of the cycle pays no maintenance fee.
- **Linked checking**: holding, when the cycle closes, an active checking account of one of the named tiers waives the fee.
- **Relationship balance**: a relationship balance, measured at cycle close, at or above this figure waives the fee.

## Reading the table

**Which tier never charges the fee?** Goal Builder Savings: its fee is 0.00 and it lists no waiver routes because none is needed.

**A hypothetical Money Market Account owner kept a lowest balance of 2600.00 all cycle. Is the balance route met?** Yes, 2600.00 is above that tier's 2500.00 level.

**Can a Starter Savings owner rely on a Premier Checking account?** No. The linked-checking route is not offered on Starter Savings.
